trello.name: Fix Android photo upload crash on Android 14
trello.desc: Marcus will fix the NullPointerException crash that occurs in the media picker callback when the app is backgrounded mid-photo upload on Android 14. The fix must be completed and verified by Wednesday to allow QA time before the August 20 mobile release. Sam will confirm the fix on Android 14 test devices and add it to the regression test suite.

trello.name: Implement offline mode for notes list
trello.desc: Elena will build the backend sync API for notes with last-write-wins conflict resolution during this sprint. Marcus will implement the client side with local caching using Room, allowing offline viewing and editing of notes with write queuing and replay on reconnection. The feature must meet acceptance criteria enabling use of the app in airplane mode with no data loss upon reconnection.

trello.name: Migrate CI pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Sam will complete migration of CI test and release pipelines to GitHub Actions this sprint while maintaining the nightly build schedule. Both Jenkins and GitHub Actions will run in parallel for a week before Jenkins is deactivated, pending a clean parallel run.

trello.name: Add per-user rate limiting and metrics to search endpoint
trello.desc: Elena will add a per-user rate limit of 100 requests per minute to the search endpoint, returning HTTP 429 with Retry-After headers when exceeded. She will also implement a metrics counter for tracking usage to prevent future degradation incidents.

trello.name: Update privacy policy screen for GDPR compliance
trello.desc: Marcus will update the consent screen to comply with GDPR for the EU launch in the August 20 release. The updated screen must use opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, with no pre-checked boxes, using copy provided by legal.

trello.name: Add automated regression tests for payments flow
trello.desc: Sam will write regression tests covering purchase, restore, cancellation, and receipt validation paths in the payments flow. These tests will be integrated into the new GitHub Actions CI pipeline for automated coverage.
